page: Google Cloud Platform c4n-highmem-8-lssd is an x86_64 architecture virtual server belonging to the c4n instance family. It is configured with 8 dedicated vCPUs and 62.0 GB of system memory, establishing a resource density of 7.75 GB of RAM per virtual core. This high memory-to-vCPU ratio supports workloads that require significant memory footprints relative to compute capacity.

Storage is provided via a single local NVMe SSD with a capacity of 403 GB, offering low-latency read and write operations directly attached to the instance. The server does not include any integrated GPU accelerators, nor does it provide any complimentary public IPv4 addresses, meaning external networking configurations are required for public internet connectivity.

The combination of dedicated CPU allocation, high memory density, and local NVMe storage makes this server profile suitable for memory-bound applications. Typical workloads include database hosting, caching layers, and localized data processing tasks that benefit from fast scratch space without the need for hardware acceleration.
